messages:
alex: Heads-up: q8 quant bringup for long-window tests is showing regressions on our LLM-bench longprompt suite. Need to refresh the golden set + adjust dedupe before we blame kernels.

nina: Can you paste the delta numbers? latency looking okay but quality drop concerns :eyes:

alex: Quick top-line: avg ROUGE-L -2.7pts on L2 long samples, failure-rate 1.2% -> 4.8% for >2048 tokens, tail-token entropy +0.35. I'll attach sample slices.

sam: I can rerun q8 with prefix-KV-cache enabled and try embed-dedupe @ 0.86 threshold. If we can test that vs baseline fast.

labelops: We have capacity to relabel ~1k edgecases this week. Do you want a golden refresh (hand audit) or just flag them as 'holdout' for eval?

alex: Both: 500 into golden relabel (hand audit) + 1k holdout set for metric sweep. I'll export prioritized list to /shared/curation/q8-longwindow.csv

eden: Important: if we change dedupe threshold, record fingerprint seeds + tokenizer version. Long prompts change tokenization; might explain part of the drift.

sam: Quick dedupe command I run locally:

```bash
python tools/dedupe_cli.py --input q8-longwindow.csv --embed-model all-MiniLM --thresh 0.86 --out deduped.csv
```

nina: Can we gate rollout? propose canary 10% traffic + auto-fallback to fp16 if quality delta > 1.5% on production holdouts.

deploy-bot: Canary started for q8-longwindow (10% traffic). Dashboard: https://console.redwood/deploys/q8-longwindow

labelops: I'll create a golden rubric doc and schedule labelers. tagging @alex for ambiguous-case decisions.

alex: Thanks — dropping CSV + short rubric in the thread in ~30m. Anyone who can help with quick audits, ping me :pray:
